params.swapData: The raw transaction payload from the 1inch API (includes selector)

params._tradeSizes: Array of trade sizes to execute at each tick

params._newTradeSizes: Updated array of trade sizes from current tick onwards.

params.recipient: The address to send remaining funds to.
params.token: The ERC20 token address to withdraw.

abortSchedule().notice: Circuit breaker for off-chain solver or owner to pause execution

calculateExpectedReturn(uint256,uint256).notice: Computes expected return using decimal-normalized cross-asset math

executeTick(bytes).notice: Triggered by Chainlink Upkeep to execute the next trade in the schedule

proposeWithdrawal(address,address).notice: Proposes a withdrawal under institutional timelock (Gnosis Safe timelock workflow).

resumeSchedule().notice: Resumes execution after pause if owner verifies market stabilization

setAssetDecimals(uint8,uint8).notice: Configures token decimals for cross-asset expected return calculations

setMaxConsecutiveFailures(uint256).notice: Configures consecutive failures threshold for automated circuit breaker

setMaxOracleDelay(uint256).notice: Configures maximum allowable oracle staleness delay in seconds

setMaxSlippageBps(uint256).notice: Configures maximum permissible slippage tolerance in basis points

setTimelockDelay(uint256).notice: Configures timelock delay for withdrawal proposals

updateSchedule(uint256[]).notice: Mid-flight re-optimization checkpoint: allows the off-chain solver to update         the remaining execution schedule based on realized volatility without resetting accumulators.

updateUpkeepAgent(address).notice: Allows the owner to update the upkeep agent address.

withdrawRemaining(address,address).notice: Allows owner (or Gnosis Safe) to withdraw remaining tokens when PAUSED or IDLE.         Hardened with timelock verification and SafeERC20 compatibility.
